name: Kagi Mail
desc: Private email and calendar that sorts out the noise for you.
desc_zh: 会自动筛掉骚扰信息的私密邮箱和日历
solves: Newsletters and cold pitches bury the people actually waiting on a reply. Kagi Mail keeps them out of the way and flags phishing before you open it.
solves_zh: 订阅邮件和陌生推销把真正等你回复的人埋在了下面。Kagi Mail 会把这些邮件挡开，并在你打开前提示钓鱼风险。
best_for: Your inbox is a to-do list you never asked for and the important reply is three scrolls down.
best_for_zh: 收件箱变成了没人要求的待办清单，而那封重要的回复压在三次滚动之下。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://kagi.com/changelog and https://blog.kagi.com/ , then the Kagi produc）。 Public beta on 2026-11-23 with a 60-day free trial, then $99/year or included with Kagi Ultimate. It comes with a @kagimail.com address or a custom domain, plus a calendar. Distinct from the ledger's Kagi Assistant: this is a separate product with its own page and price. No media source was read. 首次公开日期来源：https://blog.kagi.com/kagi-mail-public-beta
